4a1f5e1e-e0d6-4a51-98c9-c878afc3c903.name: Reference mockup — gameplay visual direction

A tiny hooded child in a ragged burlap cloak stands in the center with a faint red thread around one wrist, holding black inky tears that float upward. Around the room: two pale moths with dusty wings, a crawling stitched husk doll with button eyes, a cracked stone pillar, scattered bones, an iron-banded wooden door in the top wall, a small puddle reflecting candlelight. Dark soot-black ink outlines, rough iron-gall line work, old paper grain texture, muted palette of bone cream, parchment tan, damp olive stone, dried blood red and one thread-red accent. Minimal diegetic HUD icons only at the corners: three small stitched hearts top-left, a tiny gold coin and bone key, a scrap of parchment minimap top-right; no readable text anywhere. Wide 16:9 composition with the room centered and generous dark surround. Painterly yet graphic, tactile like an old print, cohesive, atmospheric, playful-creepy.
